issues.title: Missing Leaf Files (02-13) in Context
issues.why: The walker cap (120KB) has excluded the actual component specifications (Sidebar, Buttons, Typography details). An AI cannot implement the 'Sidebar' or 'Button' logic with 100% confidence because the normative files (02-13) are physically missing from the provided text.
issues.fix: Consolidate the core normative requirements for Sidebar, Buttons, and Typography into the 00-overview.md or provide them as separate modules.

issues.title: Truncated Acceptance Criteria and Changelog
issues.why: The context ends abruptly in the middle of the Changelog and Acceptance Criteria (AC-39 is mentioned in the header but the file is truncated). The AI lacks the full set of constraints for the latest version.
issues.fix: Reduce the verbosity of historical changelog entries to ensure the latest normative ACs and release notes fit within the 120KB context window.

issues.title: Undefined 'linter-scripts' and 'linter-commands'
issues.why: AC-DS-000 and the CI Workflow stage references rely on external scripts (e.g., detect-changed-modules.sh, validate-contracts.py) that are not defined or provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the source code or a detailed functional spec for the referenced linter-scripts in a 'Dependencies' section.
